command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# R needs a writable TMPDIR *and* HOME or it fails early and opaquely.
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
# spawn's task shell drops the image PATH.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.R does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
Rscript identities.R 2>&1 | tee identities.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'GLMNET IDENTITIES OK' identities.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
test -s score.tsv || { echo "FAIL: score.tsv missing or empty"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
